scenes.say: You knew gold would rise? The market disagreed.

scenes.text: You want to be right – instead of making money. The market doesn't know your opinion.
scenes.say: Ego trading: you want to be right instead of making money.

scenes.text: Spot the warning phrases: “It has to turn now.” “I'll wait until I'm back in profit.”
scenes.say: One: spot the warning phrases. It has to turn now.

scenes.label: STEP 02 · Example
scenes.sub: Plan: $100 risk. Ego: added three times.
scenes.say: Two: the plan was one hundred dollars of risk. Ego makes it six hundred.

scenes.title: STEP 03 · The fix

items.right: Into the journal, not the ego

scenes.say: Three: decide upfront when you're wrong. Then get out, no debate.

scenes.text: Pros are often wrong. They just don't stay wrong for long.
